author: Matthew Adam
title: Slade Cecconi solid, but Guardians drop 2-1 to Brewers
desc: Slade Cecconi allowed one earned run on three hits and two walks while striking out four over 5.2 innings in Tuesday's 2-1 loss to the Brewers
impact: Cecconi pitched well but couldn't get any run support in the start. After the outing, he owns a 4.60 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with a 3-5 record across 15 starts. He has rounded into form after a rough start to the season, posting a 2.89 ERA over his past seven starts.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Trevor Larnach racks up four hits in 12-2 rout
desc: Trevor Larnach went 4-for-6 in a 12-2 win over the Rangers on Tuesday with a home run, two runs scored, and one RBI.
impact: Larnach kicked off the scoring with a first-inning homer, a blast that traveled 425 feet with an exit velocity of 108.8 MPH. After Tuesday's win, Larnach is batting .264 with four home runs, 18 RBI, 31 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 60 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kody Clemens clubs HR, racks up three RBI in rout
desc: Kody Clemens went 2-for-4 in a 12-2 win over the Rangers on Tuesday with a home run, a double, two runs scored, and three RBI.
impact: Clemens ripped a three-run homer in the third inning to give the Twins a 5-0 lead. After Tuesday's win, Clemens is batting .251 with 11 home runs, 28 RBI, 31 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 62 games. He has a .286 average and five homers over his past 15 games.

author: David Leisering
title: Brandon Lowe hits go-ahead blast in ninth Tuesday
desc: Brandon Lowe had just one hit in five at bats on Tuesday, but his lone hit was a go-ahead solo home run in the ninth to lift the Pirates to a 6-5 win over the Athletics.
impact: Lowe was 0-for-4 with three strikeouts before taking Elvis Alvarado deep for a solo home run in the ninth inning to complete the Pirates' comeback. It was his 18th home run of the season, tying him for fifth in the National League. However, Lowe has been struggling at the dish, hitting just .164 (10-for-61) over his last 15 games. Four of his ten hits during that span have left the yard, so his power is still helping fantasy owners. Overall, Lowe is slashing .239/.321/.511 with 18 home runs and 47 RBI across 68 games this season.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Byron Buxton cashes in three runs in rout of Texas
desc: Byron Buxton went 1-for-4 in a 12-2 win over the Rangers on Tuesday with three runs scored, one stolen base, and one walk.
impact: Through 63 games, Buxton is slashing .275/.336/.601 with 23 home runs, 36 RBI, 51 runs scored, seven steals, and a .393 wOBA. He's hitting .444 with four homers and two steals over his past seven contests.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Jacob Young Chips In, Swipes Bag in Win
desc: Jacob Young went 1-for-4 in a win over the Royals with a stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: After Tuesday's win, Young is slashing .235/.285/.394 with eight home runs, seven stolen bases, 28 RBI and 31 runs scored across 72 games.

author: David Leisering
title: Bryan Reynolds homers twice in comeback win Tuesday
desc: Bryan Reynolds went 4-for-5 with two home runs, three runs scored, and three runs batted in on Tuesday, helping the Pirates to a 6-5 comeback victory over the Athletics.
impact: Reynolds belted a solo home run off of Jack Perkins in the sixth and then took Hogan Harris deep for a two-run shot in the eighth. He added a pair of singles for his first four-hit game since May 27 of last season against the Diamondbacks. Reynolds has now hit safely in eight straight games and is hitting .406 (13-for-32) with seven runs scored, three doubles, four home runs, and six runs batted in during the streak. He's now slashing .280/.400/.470 with 10 home runs and 45 RBI through 74 games this season.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: CJ Abrams chips in hit, swipe in 6-4 win
desc: CJ Abrams went 1-for-4 in a win over the Royals with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: After Tuesday's win, Abrams is batting .285 with 14 home runs, 53 RBI and 11 stolen bases across 72 games. Abrams continues to rank in the top 10 in the NL in multiple offensive categories.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Zebby Matthews Works Seven in Easy Win
desc: Zebby Matthews kept things mostly tidy, and the Twins' offense did the rest in a 12-2 rout of the Rangers. Matthews allowed two earned runs on eight hits and no walks while striking out four over seven innings.
impact: Matthews bounced back from a rough time in his prior outing, which saw him allow seven runs over six innings. After the win, he now owns a 4.78 ERA and 1.18 WHIP with a 3-4 record through seven starts. His next start will be Monday against the Dodgers.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Gus Varland locks down save despite shaky line
desc: Gus Varland allowed one earned run on one hit and one walk while striking out one batter to earn the save in Tuesday's 6-4 win over the Royals.
impact: After Tuesday's win over the Royals, Varland now has a 5.20 ERA and 1.66 WHIP with seven saves, two blown saves and six holds across 31 appearances. Garland has really struggled as of late, allowing six earned runs in his last seven appearances.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Foster Griffin Grinds Through Six in Win Over Royals
desc: Foster Griffin kept it mostly tidy, even if the pitch count suggests the Royals didn't exactly roll over.
impact: Griffin allowed one earned run on six hits and two walks while striking out six over six innings in Tuesday's win over the Royals. After the win, Griffin now has a 3.32 ERA and 1.11 WHIP with an 7-2 record across 15 starts. He is slated to make his next start against the Phillies.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Curtis Mead cashes in with three-run blast in 6-4 win
desc: Curtis Mead went 1-for-3 in a win over the Royals with a home run, one walk, one run scored and three RBI.
impact: After Tuesday's win, Mead is slashing .236/.343/.478 with 11 home runs, 34 RBI, 32 runs scored and three stolen bases across 58 games. Hopefully for Mead this is able to jump start a turnaround, as he has just four hits in his last 24 at-bats.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Brandon Young's shaky command sinks Orioles in Seattle
desc: Brandon Young allowed three earned runs on four hits and four walks while striking out two over six innings in Tuesday's 3-1 loss to the Mariners.
impact: After the loss, Young now has a 3.18 ERA and 1.25 WHIP with a 5-2 record through 11 starts. This marks Young's fifth straight quality start. The young right-hander is slated for a tough matchup with the Dodgers in his next outing.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Keaton Winn (elbow) to begin throwing progression this week
desc: Keaton Winn is scheduled to begin a throwing progression by the end of the week.
impact: Winn was placed on the 15-day injured list June 14 after experiencing soreness following a throwing session. However, an MRI revealed no significant damage, and he is expected to return by early July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Clay Holmes (fibula) begins playing catch
desc: Clay Holmes has begun playing light catch.
impact: Holmes fractured his right fibula on a comebacker May 15. He has begun throwing, but is still in the early stages of his rehab and is not expected to return until August.
